notes: SA-01: the closed vocabularies and limits of the declarative AutomationSkill document.
The Python validator (automation_tool.executor.automation_skill) and every later SA stage read these values from here, so a vocabulary change is one edit and one review.
Raw coordinates are evidence-only by construction: no goal or condition kind carries a coordinate field.
Fill values may only reference runtime parameters; literal text would smuggle user prose into a stored, replayed document.
